items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Well, my uncle owned that last. He sold it out before he died. He bought Martin out and it was called Brunus and Bruning's. No relations.

ctx.x: I think Martin's is still there, huh?

Well, my uncle owned that last. He sold it out before he died. He bought Martin out and it was called Brunus and Bruning's. No relations. Yeah. So Bruning wanted me. I sat in there one time and I was in the union. I was a punk kid. So Bruning's is, the drummer at Bruning's was the secretary of the union. He says, I want this boy in the union. He says, I want him to work here. So he put up the $50 and I went, I had to go down to the union for examination, you know. Yeah. So I went in on cymbals. What was that? To…
You got in as a cymbal player.
